prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in can be helpful (won after adoption selection at +5.5% and photo upload at +3.3%), but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Redesigns and layout changes often showed no clear effect or caused severe negative drops (-17.2%), though the Stage Layout Pick Friend redesign was helpful (+7.1% won).
Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1% won) and path selection helper hints (+3.5% won) were helpful, but sound cues, notification toggles/banners, and overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Copy updates and waiting screen progress or time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently over-optimistic for non-winning tests, predicting up to +12.0% where no clear effect was measured.
Predictions underestimated several winning tests, such as sign-in reordering (-8.0% predicted vs +3.3% measured), path helper hints (+0.2% vs +3.5%), and stage layout redesign (-5.0% vs +7.1%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -4.9% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -1.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +2.8% over 3 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.4% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.2% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -4.5% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 82.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.2%

Changes:
0: [sign_in, incentive] Pet Cloud Sync Security Highlight on Sign-In: Displays a prominent cloud save badge and reassuring sync message on the Sign-In screen clarifying that signing in secures pet progress across sessions. (why: Addresses the top support complaint (8 emails reporting pet data loss/reset on re-sign-in) while encouraging higher sign-in completion.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Scroll Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen layout to story_scroll with an animated companion mascot introducing the app experience. (why: Enhancing early engagement on the initial screen builds momentum before users hit path selection.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Split Layout Redesign: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a split layout featuring clear example visual card slots for standard photo framing. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results; side-by-side visual examples improve photo quality and lower drop-off on adoption (64.1%).)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Dedicated Pet Naming Screen in Adoption Flow: Adds a dedicated pet naming screen ('new_pet_naming') after pick_friend where users enter their pet's official name. (why: Adoption has the steepest funnel drop-off (64.1% conversion, 1017s mean time); early customization increases psychological ownership and completion.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Accuracy Guidance Hint on Upload Screen: Adds a helpful hint banner on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and angle requirements. (why: Directly targets support tickets regarding failed or strange-looking custom pet generations (3 emails).)
5: [home, redesign] Spotlight Layout Redesign for Waiting Screen: Redesigns the waiting screen into a spotlight layout showcasing an animated mascot hatching animation. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s); a prominent visual focal point keeps users engaged while generation completes.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Check Screen Before Onboarding Finish: Adds a new screen ('new_visibility_check') right after home_intro where users confirm their pet is visible on the desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or app opening issues, and finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Card Layout Redesign: Redesigns home_intro into a clean card layout with a high-visibility completion badge. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with long mean delays (5815s); a structured card design highlights setup completion clearly.)
8: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-In Centered Layout Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a clean centered layout with a step progress indicator. (why: 2 support tickets noted sign-in stalling or failing to load cleanly; a simplified centered layout improves stability and sign-in completion.)
